ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Sponsor sales, Contract out and later stages need Amount, Close date and Payment terms.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Sponsor_sales", CASE(StageName, "Prospect", 1, "Meeting held", 2, "Proposal sent", 3, "Negotiating", 4, "Contract out", 5, "Signed", 6, 0) >= 5, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(CloseDate), ISBLANK(TEXT(Payment_terms__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Close date and Payment terms before moving to Contract out.
